recommendation_scope: Standalone conservative calibrated bbox grouping and backward compatibility; not factory duplicate-detection accuracy, mask fusion, QC or production activation.

semantics.adjacency: Explicit unordered adjacent camera pairs; default empty means no guessed adjacency or automatic merge.
semantics.identity: Same capture_group/fabric/verified lot+roll/frame index/typed transport position; aware timestamps within explicit tolerance.
semantics.classification: Exact source_kind and label agreement, same model version/hash/reference declarations; no score averaging or highest-score suppression.
semantics.geometry: Recompute mapped rectangles from source pixels and one calibration snapshot; clip to shared horizontal FOV, then require seam IoU and center distance.
semantics.grouping: Connected match components merge only with one observation per camera, every member pair eligible (complete link), and no incident conflict/review warnings. Ambiguous/non-complete components remain separate.
semantics.lineage: Every accepted observation retained exactly once in a group with original pixel candidate, raw score, source provenance, frame and independent mapping.
semantics.merged_geometry: Envelope of original mapped bboxes, NOT mask union or measured defect area.
semantics.limits: Explicit list/tuple input, default max128/hard max256; invalid/duplicate/over-limit batches raise ValueError without silent filtering/truncation.
semantics.business_qc: affects_qc=false; diagnostic review is not GOOD/NEEDS_REVIEW/BAD.

tests.warning: Existing FAISS loader NumPy private-namespace deprecation.

git.note: Cumulative tracked diff belongs to prior phases and preexisting user binary; Phase 14 adds new untracked files only.

demo.note: Synthetic bbox grouping with exact source lineage. Starting match tolerances are NOT calibrated factory acceptance rules; envelope is not a mask/defect-area union. Phase 15 has not started.

limitations: Synthetic linear calibration and starting IoU/distance/time tolerances only; no real-world duplicate precision/recall or calibration residuals measured.
BBox matching only; supervised model-grid masks need a verified source-coordinate transform first. Envelope is not mask area or customer severity.
No same-camera tile NMS, rolling temporal tracking, greedy matching, score fusion or automatic suppression of conflicting classes.
All members must form an unambiguous complete-link camera group; transitive overlap chains and one-to-many matches remain separate for review.
Capture IDs, versions/hashes and transport/time metadata are caller declarations, not hardware synchronization/content/provenance attestation.
Exact count/position/frame identity and provenance matching may retain real duplicates across delayed/heterogeneous cameras.
Phase 13 bridge is explicit offline; partial chunk geometry must match a valid calibration, otherwise mapping remains unavailable.
No automatic API/SQLite/annotation/defect-count/QC changes, model activation or Phase 15 profiling/scheduler work.
